decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The glazing of the southern elevation of the conservatory shall be obscure/ frosted glazing with any windows to be hinged to open inwards. The glazing shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscure/ frosted glazing.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The demolition of the existing rear conservatory and the erection of a new single storey conservatory to the existing house, as shown on drawing Job No. 5392 Drawing No. 1, received 20 April 2006, would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties and would satisfactorily maintain the street scene. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
description: Demolition of existing rear conservatory and erection of a new single storey conservatory with flat roof to house.
